title: Cloud Test Machine power
summary: A Test Machine whose settings record cloud_instance_id is an EC2 instance powered from the executing machine with the project's aws-admin key. Contract materialization (resolve_contract_host_control), yoke test-machine operations and declared-host Commands start a stopped instance, wait for instance-running and an SSH banner on port 22, then continue. Each client flow that ends a lease (operations, standalone cases, plan runs, mission walk-end, review submit, plan abort) then stops every running cloud machine of the project with no active lease; a queued waiter's reserved turn is a lease, so the host runs until the last one ends, and a lease the server released alone is caught by the next flow. Start failures refuse with test_machine_power_start_failed, test_machine_power_ssh_unreachable or test_machine_power_aws_unavailable, each naming the recovery; stop problems print test_machine_power_stop_failed and never change the flow's result. An instance without an Elastic IP is never stopped (test_machine_power_stop_skipped), because its registered host address would change. Machines without cloud_instance_id are untouched. Source behavior awaits live CloudTrail proof.
